def CanyonSearch (a : Array Int) (b : Array Int) (h_precond : CanyonSearch_precond (a) (b)) : Nat :=
  let a_to_list : List Int := a.toList
  let b_to_list : List Int := b.toList
  let init_min : Nat := (a_to_list.head! - b_to_list.head!).natAbs
  let rec search (i : Nat) (j : Nat) (current_min : Nat) : Nat :=
    if i >= a_to_list.length ∨ j >= b_to_list.length then current_min
    else
      let diff := (a_to_list.get! i - b_to_list.get! j).natAbs
      let new_min := min current_min diff
      if i + 1 < a_to_list.length ∧ j + 1 < b_to_list.length then
        search (i + 1) (j + 1) new_min
      else if i + 1 < a_to_list.length then
        search (i + 1) j new_min
      else if j + 1 < b_to_list.length then
        search i (j + 1) new_min
      else
        current_min
  search 0 0 init_min
